name: writinglint-monorepo
description: A grammar linter for prose — authorable rules that match over a real dependency-parse + POS graph. Ships an AI-writing-style rulepack.
author: Nikhil Verma

scripts.build:cf: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['packages/web/public/model','packages/web/public/ort'])fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run build:site -w writinglint-web
scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w writinglint-core -w writinglint-parser-node -w writinglint-rulepack-ai-style -w writinglint-rulepack-craft -w writinglint -w slopsift
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.client.json && npm run typecheck:apps
scripts.typecheck:apps: npm run check-types -w slopsift-chrome-extension -w slopsift-vscode -w slopsift-web
scripts.setup-stanza: uv sync --project experiments/stanza && uv run --project experiments/stanza python packages/parser-node/python/download_stanza.py --model-dir experiments/stanza/.models
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:libs
scripts.pack:check: npm run setup-model && npm run build:libs && node scripts/check-packages.mjs
scripts.release: npm run check && npm run pack:check && changeset publish
